title: TypeScript + Next.js + Cursor extension on macOS
prompt: I'm building a Cursor extension in TypeScript with .cursorrules for a Next.js codebase that ships to Vercel. Running on macOS Sequoia. I want fast iteration and code review.
expected_notes: Target should be 'cursor', language 'typescript', platform 'macos'. SDK should be TS-flavored (NOT Python fastmcp). Method skill should pick a code-review tool. Should NOT pick Python-only tools as primary anywhere.
